writing.explanation: Shunting-Yard Parsing belongs to Stack, Queue & Monotonic Patterns. Its invariant is the part that stays true after every step; tracing that invariant is more reliable than memorising lines. Typical uses include infix parsing and calculator implementations.
writing.feedback: The invariant explains both correctness and which state may change.
